363	I told you, a Nasi has the power to decree decrees and enact laws.
364	Rabbi Meir entered the beit midrash, and they don't stand.
365	Look at them, look at those who do this for him, they don't stand.
366	Suddenly Rabbi Natan entered, and they don't stand.
367	He said to them, not for my honor, okay?
368	What's going on here, what's going on?
369	Come explain to me, what is happening here today?
370	They said, the Nasi decreed that no one stands for anyone, only for the Nasi.
371	Wow, what is this?
372	They said to him, yes.
373	They stand only for the Nasi, it's over, that's what he enacted, they no longer stand for you.

375	rabbinic titles and so on, but we don't stand.

377	uprooting mountains, grinding one against the other.
